review.notes: Full review of an unchanged head. Earlier findings R02 and R03 repaired, R01 partly (remainder is small correction C06). All 15 sampled targets and the 4 headline theorems recomputed (adversarial table with values in the report); 32 source locators checked against the text (OkonekTeleman1996 22, Witten1994 6, BBMW2002 4); Taubes 1995 not readable (HTTP 403), listed under Not verifiable. Every backticked library name resolves at the pins; all 14 suppliers and their cited sections resolved on main and at the open heads that revise them. Automatic checks all passed, none set aside; dependency check 0 problems, no UPWARD or CYCLE; Suggested.lean elaborates with no message and declares nothing (no headline statable at the pins). Small corrections: reversed Sobolev orders of the inverse in 4.4; FourManifolds 4.1 credited with U(2) lifts in 11.1; restatements of SpinGeometry 6.1 and IndexTheory 6.3; Mathlib DividedPowers unnamed and the description's claim; thirteen sections without locators. Two source issues recorded.
